new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/harvested"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("<uuid>")
.respond(
        template(HttpTemplate.TemplateType.JAVASCRIPT)
                .withTemplate("if (request.method === 'POST' && request.path === '/somePath') {\n    return {\n        'statusCode': 200,\n        'body': JSON.stringify({name: 'value'})\n    };\n} else {\n    return {\n        'statusCode': 406,\n        'body': request.body\n    };\n}")
                .withDelay(new Delay(TimeUnit.SECONDS, 5))
);
